subject: health
concept: Applying heart/lung, muscle/bone, digestive, immune, and sensory care habits to a full body-care routine, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a body-care routine chart covering all the systems from this unit
exercise.abstract: Student explains how their routine takes care of their whole body

assessment.mastery_threshold: routine addresses at least four distinct body-care areas from this unit
misconception_flags: routine focuses on only one body system while ignoring the others covered in this unit

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
